text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A puppet drama show, huh...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, for the sake of Wafumofu Tamasaburo 
and friends,
I would like your cooperation 
in filming.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I get the 'promoting the leftover
plushies 
from the bazaar' part. But why go outta 
your way to make a drama?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...There's gotta be a reason you're so
set 
on a 'drama', right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just 'getting people to buy them' is not 
enough. They'll just be forgotten again 
soon, and their fate of going to the sea 
won't change――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: But if there's a story, fate can change.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
――Yes, a story that makes people want to 
stay together with these little ones
for a 
long, long time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It might just be a futile struggle, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Y'know, it's like with second-hand 
bikes too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When the previous owner talks about their 
memories with it, you end up wanting to 
'take good care of it', right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm in! If we're doing this, 
let's make something wicked awesome!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, once it's decided,
we gotta act 
fast. We don't have much time until the 
next bazaar!

The day of the bazaar. Curious about how 
Aston Machan was doing,
I went to check on 
things――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A puppet drama show made by yours truly! 
Now screening! Come check it out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Starring none other than the plushies for 
sale! It's super fun, come have a look~~!

text_block_list.name: Motchiro
text_block_list.text:
"So if we find that legendary supercar,
we 
can reach the new frontier?! But whether 
we can actually find it or not is...!"

text_block_list.name: Agent Mar
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, cannot find. A mushy waste of 
effort..."

text_block_list.name: Agent Mar
text_block_list.text:
"However, if we all struggle together... 
there is a chance fate can change――!!"

text_block_list.name: Wafumofu Tamasaburo
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, Mar's right! Just waiting around 
for the end is lame as hell! Let's fight 
tooth and nail with everything we got!"

text_block_list.name: Mascots
text_block_list.text: "Let's aim for the new frontier――!"

Applause erupted the moment the END card 
appeared――the audience's reaction was 
overwhelmingly positive.
choice_data_list: That was an amazing promotional idea.
That was an amazing promotional idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*Smug*. Fufu,
thank you very much for your 
help back then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chan always thought going to the sea
was 
'fate', but――

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Customer A
text_block_list.text:
'Motchiro'!
I had one of those back in the 
day. Guess I'll buy it as a souvenir for 
my daughter!

text_block_list.name: Bazaar Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Woooah, I'll take this one! Wafumofu 
Tamasaburo! Your new frontier is my 
house...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your business! Heh, make sure 
you take good care of 'em...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When you struggle for all you're worth,
it 
turns out things can change quite a 
bit――fate, that is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for sparking
Ma-chan's 
Copernican revolution.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? What are your 
thoughts on this 'story'?
choice_data_list: Must've been tough getting it all ...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Indeed, indeed. *Smug*.
choice_data_list: It was a truly memorable story.
Must've been tough to finish it, r...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
it seems everyone won't have to head 
to the sea for quite a while, and so――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah. I shall give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Quite so. It's a token of gratitude for 
giving everyone the catalyst to find
their 
new frontier.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In return,
please be the Ma-chan plushie's 
new frontier for a long, long time to 
come.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Ma-chan struggled quite a bit. 
Ma-chan's circle of friends went full 
throttle, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Vodka had 11 blooper retakes, which made 
Scarlet go all pouting and fuming――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san helped edit the video,
Biko-san 
gave action coaching, Akebono-san brought 
refreshments...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are more behind-the-scenes filming 
stories than I could possibly tell.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And in turn――the memories between Ma-chan 
and everyone grew by leaps and bounds as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... All thanks to a good struggle, 
isn't it?
